integrity.reproducibility: Standalone exact-rational verification program included. Finite checks support but do not substitute for the proof.

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to resolvents of four-dimensional nonzero weighted nilpotent shifts under permutations of a fixed magnitude multiset.
For 0<p<1, the power sum is not represented as a Schatten norm.
No assertion of monotonicity is made for every individual singular value, every Ky Fan norm, or larger matrices.
An equivalent unindexed historical formula cannot be excluded; the full printable Chang-Wang paper could not be inspected.
title: Strict Schatten rearrangement for four-site weighted-shift resolvents
